standard.summary: 训练开始前给每张图打分，找出和这套数据集整体风格不像的图，结果写进输出目录的 lulynx_look_filter_report.json。只出报告，不动你的文件。
standard.effect: 默认关闭。开启后会在第一步之前遍历全部图片，因此首步延迟明显；报告里给出离群数量与明细。
standard.whenToUse: 怀疑数据集混进了风格不一致的图、想先看证据再决定清理时。
standard.avoidWhen: 没有自备 ONNX embedding 权重时——开关打开但路径为空会被拒绝提交。数据集很大又赶时间时也不必开，它会实打实地拖慢启动。

standard_en.summary: Scores every image against the dataset's own look centroid before training and writes lulynx_look_filter_report.json into the output directory. Report only: nothing is moved or deleted.
standard_en.effect: Off by default. When on it walks every image before step 1, so the first step is noticeably delayed; the report carries the outlier count and details.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you suspect the dataset holds style-inconsistent images and want evidence before cleaning up.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Without a user-supplied ONNX embedding model -- enabling the check with an empty path is rejected. Skip it on a large dataset when time matters: it genuinely slows startup.

advanced.principle: lulynx_look_filter.settings 解析开关与阈值（默认 action=plan），look_filter_preparation 在训练准备期扫图片、打相似度分、把低于阈值的图标记为离群，全过程只写报告。即使 action 设成 quarantine / delete，准备期也不会移动或删除任何文件，只在报告里提示「用数据集工具执行同一份计划」。
advanced.intervention: 训练准备期的一次性打分开销，训练循环里没有该分支。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无显存占用（取决于 likeness_device 选择），但首步前多一次全量图片遍历。
advanced.tradeoffs: 阈值是相似度下界，不是离群比例，换数据集就得重标；报告只覆盖打分成功且解码正常的图，坏图不进离群名单。

advanced_en.principle: lulynx_look_filter.settings parses the toggle and threshold (action defaults to plan), and look_filter_preparation scans images during training preparation, scores them and flags those below the threshold as outliers -- writing a report the whole way. Even with action set to quarantine / delete, preparation never moves or deletes anything; it only notes in the report that the dataset tool should execute the same plan.
advanced_en.intervention: A one-off scoring cost during training preparation; the training loop has no such branch.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No VRAM cost (depending on likeness_device), but one full image pass before the first step.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The threshold is a similarity floor, not an outlier rate, so a new dataset needs re-calibration; the report only covers images that scored and decoded cleanly, so broken images never appear as outliers.
